title: Kiran Mani of JioStar to join OpenAI as Managing Director, APAC, in June - The HinduBusinessLine
summary: Kiran Mani, founder and CEO of JioHotStar, is set to join OpenAI as the Managing Director for Asia Pacific, leading regional strategy and operations. OpenAI, which has significant enterprise adoption in APAC, especially in India, Japan, and Indonesia, is expanding its international presence.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights a positive move for OpenAI with the appointment of a key regional leader and its strong presence in the APAC market.
